criteria.requirement: Add yaml.tagged TaggedValue plus PreservingLoader/Dumper and load_preserving/dump_preserving. Unknown scalar keeps exact scalar text, unknown sequence/mapping safely constructs contents; preserve tag and node kind, recursive/shared alias identity via generator construction and representer. Unknown Python object/apply tags remain inert TaggedValue, never import/call targets. Existing known SafeLoader typing/default unknown-tag rejection unchanged; complex tagged keys with unhashable payload remain unsupported safe key errors. No global class registration changes.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
